cae encima con frecuencia. Esta enfermedad tiene el gran inconveniente de presentarse aun después de recolectada y empaquetada la fruta y asi mucha, embarcada sin duda su buena condición ha llegado á esta completamente destrozada.

aguosa que no aguanta el viaje y ambas
causas han producido pérdidas de consideración.

best that arrive here, and as the
appearances are of a short harvest in
this place—it is still early to know with certainty—it is easy that we have good demand and good prices in the next year. We are already looking for seed and we find difficulties due to the poor condition of the plantations, and it will take several weeks before we can contract,
but it would be good that our friends
send us their orders as soon as possible.
TOMATOES.—This business has developed extraordinarily and the only difficulty that weighs on this profitable crop seems to be the disease that
frequently attacks it. This disease has the great disadvantage of appearing even after the fruit has been harvested and packed, and thus much, undoubtedly shipped in good condition, has arrived here completely destroyed.
Also, in this past harvest, much very
watery fruit has been shipped, which does not withstand the journey, and both
causes have resulted in considerable losses.

—Are you telling me that because you see that we have only two chops, and it seems
little to you? Do you eat more than two?
—But, and you? asked Danton.
—Oh! I, said Marat, never eat meat in the morning; I could not work.
